import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E41A1C', 'Fuji': '#377EB8', 'Pentax': '#4DAF4A', 'Olympus': '#984EA3'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Megapixels vs Price by Brand
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], s=100, label=brand, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Megapixels vs Price by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()

# 2. Bar chart: Sensor Type Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(sensor_counts))
bars = ax2.bar(sensor_counts.index, sensor_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Camera Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Scatter plot: Weight vs Price with bubble size as megapixels
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 3)
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], 
                       s=df['megapixels']*10, c=df['model_year'], 
                       cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Weight vs Price (bubble size = megapixels)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add brand labels
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax3.annotate(row['brand'], (row['weight_grams'], row['price_usd']), 
                 fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom')

# 4. Horizontal bar chart: Price by Camera Model
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4)
camera_labels = [f"{row['brand']} ({row['model_year']})" for _, row in df.iterrows()]
colors_price = [brand_colors[brand] for brand in df['brand']]
y_pos = np.arange(len(camera_labels))
ax4.barh(y_pos, df['price_usd'], color=colors_price, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels(camera_labels)
ax4.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Camera Prices Comparison', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add price labels on bars
for i, (price, label) in enumerate(zip(df['price_usd'], camera_labels)):
    ax4.text(price + 50, i, f'${price:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
